messages:
Elena B: Heads-up: product wants a clearer deprec preview flow before we flip any defaults. We need a lightweight console preview + dry-run API, plus a clear quota/fallback story. Can we sketch constraints?
Ravi M: TL;DR: preview shows how many requests WOULD route to v1 if we changed default, plus estimated token delta and any tenants that would hit a v1 cap. Dry-run API should be non-invasive and sampled.
Console UX: UX notes: preview modal should show three columns: Current (actual), Preview (simulated split), Delta (tokens & $). Include a small explanation: "This is a simulation based on your last 24h of traffic." Action buttons: Request exemption / Apply change / Close.
Anika S: Telemetry: tag preview calls with `preview=true` and sample at 1% to avoid pollution. For real routing, add `route_version` and `soft_exit_state` tags (low-cardinality). Also emit `deprec.preview_requested` event.
Elena B: Quota story: if we enforce v1 fallback quotas, return a standard `HTTP 429` with body `{"error":"v1_quota_exceeded","hint":"Preview shows additional tokens if routed to v1"}`. Also return headers `X-V1-Grace-Remaining`. Keep wording actionable.
Ravi M: infra ask: dry-run endpoint `POST /internal/routes/{id}/simulate?window=24h&sample=0.01` should return counts + estimated bill change. Please include an example payload in the API docs.
Console UX: Small copy suggestions for modal banner: 1) Friendly: "Preview your migration to v2 — see token & cost impact." 2) Technical: "Simulation based on sampled traffic — results are estimates." We'll A/B test which drives less support churn.
Anika S: Metrics pipeline: do NOT add per-tenant high-card tags. Use `cohort=preview|active|control` and route detailed audit logs for any tenants flagged in the simulation. We'll store those in logs for 30d.
ops-bot: Reminder: set runbook trigger: if >2% of simulated tenants would hit a v1 quota in 1h window, block auto-flip and notify #eng-oncall.
Ravi M: Also, when console shows preview, include a small link "Why might outputs differ?" that lists: model weights, tokenization edge cases, and prompt handling differences. Save users time opening tickets.
Elena B: Good. Action items: Ravi -> dry-run API + example schema; Anika -> telemetry tags + sampling; Console UX -> modal mock + copy variants; Ops -> runbook thresholds. We'll review on Thurs 11am.
Console UX: I'll add two modal screenshots (friendly + technical) to the ticket and include the sample API response.
Elena B: Thanks — aim to soft-launch preview to a 500-tenant pilot next week.
